motion_intensity.definition: Overall magnitude and energy of motion within a window, including both linear and rotational components.

cadence.definition: Rate at which a meaningful periodic motion unit repeats over time. Cadence measures repetitions per unit time, not the total number of repetitions in the recording.

levels.Low: No clear periodic repetition or a slow repetition rate.

smoothness.definition: Degree to which motion changes continuously rather than through sustained rapid fluctuations.

levels.Medium: Moderately smooth motion with some fluctuations.
levels.High: Continuous and smooth motion with little fluctuation.

impulsiveness.definition: Degree to which motion contains short, abrupt, high-magnitude changes or impacts.

levels.Low: Few or no pronounced abrupt peaks.

posture_inclination.definition: Average gravity-relative inclination of the global load-bearing body configuration within a window, rather than the orientation of an isolated moving limb.

levels.High: Strongly inclined or nearly horizontal relative to gravity.

posture_variability.definition: Extent to which the global load-bearing body configuration changes relative to gravity within a window, rather than local limb-orientation changes.

rotational_motion.definition: Prominence of angular or rotational motion during the activity.

translational_motion.definition: Prominence of sustained linear progression or locomotor translation within a window.

levels.High: Prominent sustained translational or locomotor motion.

motion_regularity.definition: Temporal consistency and predictability of the motion pattern.

levels.Low: Irregular and poorly predictable motion pattern.
levels.Medium: Partly structured motion with moderate variability.

wrist_orientation_variability.definition: Extent of change in the wrist-worn watch's gravity-relative orientation within a window, independent of global body posture, rotation speed, and rotation about gravity.

levels.Low: Wrist gravity-relative orientation remains nearly constant.
levels.Medium: Wrist gravity-relative orientation spans a moderate range.
levels.High: Wrist gravity-relative orientation spans a broad range.
